verdict.rationale: GA4 documents exporting all raw events to BigQuery, with both daily full and continuous exports, and a free sandbox option. The Data API offers programmatic access to report data. Getting the data out in open formats, though, relies on BigQuery's own export to external storage, and the evidence never names the file formats, so 'open formats and leave' is only implied through a second Google product. missing for 10: documented open file formats (e.g. CSV/Parquet/JSON) directly from GA4, a first-party export path not dependent on BigQuery, independent hands-on corroboration of a full data exit.
